Usage:
  pip <command> [options]
Commands:
  install                     Install packages
  uninstall                   Remove packages
General Options:
  -h, --help                  Display help
  --isolated                  Ignore user configuration
  --python <python>           Select an interpreter
  --log <path>                Select a log path
  --keyring-provider <keyring_provider>
                              Select the credential lookup provider
  --proxy <proxy>             Configure the HTTP proxy
  --retries <retries>         Configure retry count
  --timeout <sec>             Set timeout
  --no-input                  Disable prompting
  --use-feature <feature>     Enable an experimental feature
